description: Defines the PageHeaderModel class used for representing page header information in the admin UI, including title, icon, breadcrumbs, and related properties.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Model_PageHeaderModel
classes.description: A model for describing a page header with properties like title, icon class, page type, breadcrumbs, and entity info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PageHeaderModel with optional title, icon class, page type, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name associated with the page header.

methods.name: getPageType
methods.description: Returns the type of the page (default, list, edit, new).

methods.name: getNewTargetLink
methods.description: Returns the link to the 'new target'.

methods.name: setNewTargetLink
methods.description: Sets the link to the 'new target'.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the model is empty (no title).

methods.name: getEntityBreadcrumbs
methods.description: Returns the array of breadcrumb segments.

methods.name: hasEntityList
methods.description: Checks if any breadcrumb segment includes an entity list.

methods.name: setHasEntityList
methods.description: Sets whether any breadcrumb segment includes an entity list.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a breadcrumb segment and updates entity list status.
